name: Maze Breaker
description:
About This Game

MAZE BREAKER is an action roguelite where you break through the Demon King’s ever-changing maze.

Create paths through the maze with Star Fragments, and reshape your combat style with the power of Guardian Essences.

When night falls, the maze becomes even more dangerous. Every choice, every upgrade, and every route can lead to a new strategy.

Push deeper through repeated challenges, grow stronger with each run, and reach the Demon King at the heart of the maze.

Draw Your Own Map Through the Maze

Place Star Fragments you collect during exploration to create paths that remain even as the maze shifts around you.

These connected paths become your own map, helping you navigate and take control of the ever-changing maze.

Run Across the Maze and Leap Over Walls

Dash quickly along connected Star Fragment paths with Starlight Sprint.

When the path is blocked, use Super Jump to climb onto walls and discover new routes through the maze.

Beware the Maze at Night

When night falls, the maze changes its structure, and Nightmare Monsters begin to emerge from the darkness.

Return to the safe zone before the day ends, prepare your equipment, and get ready for the next expedition.

Strengthen Your Combat with Guardian Essences

Collect Essence Fragments and obtain Guardian Essences that transform your combat abilities.

Essences from Guardians such as the Tree, Dragon, and Wolf can enhance or completely change your basic attacks, dash, parry, and charged attacks.

Create your own build with different Essence combinations in every run.

Plenty of Content for Repeated Runs

  • Five weapons and over 150 Essence abilities

  • Random events throughout the maze, including weather, traps, and monster waves

  • Multiple maze themes, including forest, snowfield, volcano, and rocky regions

  • Ever-changing maze layouts and exploration routes
short_desc: An action roguelite where you find your way through an ever-changing maze, choose combat abilities, and grow stronger with each run. Break through a maze that shifts between day and night, and reach the Demon King after repeated challenges.
